calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for smalls
calls.summary: The discussion focused on assessing Growth Book’s Enterprise plan to meet the scaling needs of Smalls, emphasizing better security, permissions, and support while also comparing pricing and features with the existing Pro plan. Key points included a shift from seat-based to experiment-based pricing, which offers flexibility and aligns with customer needs; the Enterprise plan starts at $30K/year for up to 25 users and 100 experiments. Feature enhancements in the Enterprise plan address advanced access control, audit logs, and the performance of Snowflake queries. Current challenges, such as experiment volume and quality issues, were discussed, with a focus on how these features could help increase experiment velocity. Budget sensitivity and the urgency of decision-making were also highlighted, with expectations for a quick turnaround.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Enterprise Plan, Experimentation, Pricing Model, Snowflake Optimization, Customer Support
